description: This file contains data models used throughout the grocery ordering app, including classes for Product, CartItem, Order, OrderStatus, and UserProfile.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product with fields for id, name, description, price, image URL, category, and stock status.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the shopping cart, referencing a product and quantity, with a computed subtotal.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible order states: PLACED, CONFIRMED, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer's order with an id, list of items, total amount, timestamp, and status.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Contains user profile data such as id, name, and email.

methods.name: subtotal
methods.description: Computes the subtotal cost for a cart item as quantity multiplied by product price.
